# Open Educational Resources – OERU, Oregon State University

> A comprehensive repository of peer-reviewed open textbooks and interactive learning resources covering sciences, humanities, and professional education, all freely available under Creative Commons licenses.

Oregon State University's OERU (Open Educational Resources Unit) maintains a curated collection of open textbooks authored by faculty and experts, many enhanced with interactive H5P activities. The platform serves students, educators, and institutions seeking high-quality, freely-licensed educational materials across diverse disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Open Educational Resources (OER)

## Featured Open Textbooks

- [A Dam Good Argument](https://open.oregonstate.education/goodargument): Open textbook on argumentation and persuasive writing by Delf, Drummond, and Kelly
- [Anatomy & Physiology 2e](https://open.oregonstate.education/anatomy2e): Peer-reviewed anatomy and physiology textbook for medical education
- [Allied Health Microbiology](https://open.oregonstate.education/microbiology): Open microbiology textbook by Linda Bruslind for allied health students
- [Fundamentals of Cell Biology](https://open.oregonstate.education/cellbiology): Cell biology textbook covering foundational concepts and experimental techniques
- [Inclusive Teaching Online](https://open.oregonstate.education/teachingonline): Guide to inclusive online teaching by McAlvage and Jaramillo Cherrez
- [Marine Law and Policy for Scientists and Managers](https://open.oregonstate.education/mlpsm): Marine law and ocean policy textbook by Holly V. Campbell for OSU Ecampus
- [Resisting Gender Violence](https://open.oregonstate.education/resistinggenderviolence): Gender studies textbook on resisting gender violence with global perspectives
- [New Media Futures 2e](https://open.oregonstate.education/newmediafutures2e): Media studies textbook by Daniel Faltesek on digital media and communication
- [Ancient Civilizations](https://open.oregonstate.education/ancientcivilizations): World history open textbook covering ancient civilizations and primary sources
- [Nuclear Security](https://open.oregonstate.education/nuclear-security): Security studies textbook on nuclear security and threat assessment

## Interactive Learning Activities

- [H5P Activities – A Dam Good Argument](https://open.oregonstate.education/goodargument/h5p-listing): Interactive H5P learning activities for A Dam Good Argument textbook
- [H5P Activities – Inclusive Teaching Online](https://open.oregonstate.education/teachingonline/h5p-listing): Interactive H5P activities including dialog cards for teaching online
- [H5P Activities – Resisting Gender Violence](https://open.oregonstate.education/resistinggenderviolence/h5p-listing): Interactive H5P question sets for Resisting Gender Violence textbook
- [H5P Activities – Anatomy & Physiology 2e](https://open.oregonstate.education/anatomy2e/h5p-listing): Interactive H5P quizzes and question sets for Anatomy & Physiology 2e
